name: How do I choose the right contractor for my home addition project?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my home addition project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right contractor involves evaluating their experience, communication, and track record. Look for a contractor with extensive experience in home additions, especially in your local Bay Area municipality, and ask for references and a portfolio of similar projects. Verify their licensing and insurance. A good contractor will provide a detailed proposal, clearly outline the project scope, timeline, and cost, and maintain transparent communication throughout the process. Ensure they understand your vision and can work within your budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Select a contractor by checking their experience in home additions, verifying licenses and insurance, reviewing references, and ensuring clear communication and a detailed proposal.
